description: Native macOS MIDI, reviewed stock and custom FWSC SysEx updates, and local firmware-project configuration. USB serial and UBOOT writes remain unavailable.

interface.defaultPrompt: Open FM-1 Forge and connect FM-1 directly in the native panel.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained macOS arm64 preview with a bundled runtime and native MIDI component. Connect FM-1 through native MIDI, review the official V15 package or a validated custom FWSC with its target build, then explicitly confirm the SysEx update. Durable original-attempt recovery prevents automatic retries after an uncertain transfer. Configure and save firmware-project drafts and settings locally. Codex starts the packaged server; no separately started helper is needed. Custom FWSC starts from stock V15 and verifies the exact Forge identity and build after reboot; subsequent common-firmware self-updates remain disabled. Raw MIDI commands, USB serial, UBOOT writes and compiler setup remain unavailable. Physical update acceptance is pending.

name: fm1-app-library
